clips.title: The story
paras: In Hillsbrad Foothills, gray bear tongues are raw reagents sought by the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill for experimental toxins.

Gray bears roam the wilds around Tarren Mill in several sturdy varieties. Their tongues hold heavy muscular tissue and fluids that Apothecary Lydon uses as a base ingredient for lethal solutions, including the Elixir of Suffering.
